decisions.reason: The shell-container design-target narrowing applies to the console shell, not website responsive behavior. The same message's separate acceptance of breakpoint guidance is already represented independently.

Restricting the console work to shell-container styling guidelines does not change the visual treatment of follow-on website pages. The same message separately accepts the proposed website theme treatment.
The console-shell scope change does not alter the landing-page visual design. Approval of the landing page's top half is a separate clause and is already represented by its own same-message Event.
The source decision narrows the requested console deliverable but does not change the existing landing-page font or button-color preferences.
The console dashboard's specialized build process and shell styling deliverable do not modify the separately established website implementation stack or handoff objective.
